QUOTE: "└─ nothing usable ──────────────────────────► whole_repo_scope(root)" and "section present but unusable ──────► logged as rejected, falls through (excludes-only, unknown key, no existing roots, not a mapping)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope is used when valid, and that every failure to find a usable one (rejected, missing, unusable) falls through to whole-repo indexing.
